note: One photograph, one story, permanently. Written by scripts/bind-home-images.js and read by src/lib/ledger.js. `bindings` is keyed by the normalised picture URL (keyOf in ledger.js) and never loses a key: a spent picture stays spent even after the link rots, because the promise is that it will not appear beside a second story. `leads` is one entry per day, which is what makes the top of the page change.
